compliance.terms_title: Qi Terms of Service & End User License Agreement (EULA)
compliance.terms_body:
1. Qi is a personal, local-first rhythm and journal app. Trends across sleep, heart rate, HRV, and clinical lab values are informational only and never replace licensed medical advice or diagnosis.
2. Atelier auto-renewing plans include monthly (¥18), seasonal (¥38), annual (¥98), Duo (¥168), and Family (¥228) options, alongside Lifetime Local (¥368 non-consumable). Hearth Gift Pass · Gift 1 Community Seat (+¥12) is a commercial consumable in-app purchase that deposits one prepaid 30-day Atelier seat into the community seat pool.
3. Core logging and 1 custom pet remain free forever. If a subscription ends, all journal entries, photos, letters, and created pets stay safely readable and exportable on your device.
4. Turn off auto-renewal at least 24 hours before period end via your Apple Account subscription settings.
compliance.privacy_body:
1. Local Vault by Default: Sleep logs, biomarkers, OCR extracts, notes, and custom pet photos are stored encrypted inside your local SQLite vault.
2. Zero Ad Tracking: Qi includes no third-party ad tracking SDKs and never sells, rents, or profiles your personal health data.
3. Optional Sync & Cloud AI: Data leaves your device only when you turn on end-to-end encrypted iCloud/WebDAV sync or explicitly confirm a Zero-Data-Retention cloud reflection.
